AMCA Fighter Jet Engine Deal Faces Cost Hike, India Explores Alternatives

India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) project, a fifth-generation stealth fighter program, is reportedly facing a significant challenge regarding its engine deal. The proposed agreement with a US firm for fighter jet engines is in limbo due to a nearly 300% increase in cost. This development has led India to consider alternative options, with reports indicating that British and French firms are being explored. The situation poses a potential impact on the AMCA project's development timelines and overall strategy.
